title: Cragmaw Castle · Area 10 · Postern gate

sourceRecords.title: Area 10 · South postern gate
read: An overgrown path climbs toward an iron door protected by the wall above it. Narrow slits overlook the approach.

The door offers a more contained approach than the wrecked main entrance, but the slits still overlook the ground before it. Brush crowds the path around your feet. You can examine the door and wall from a distance or decide how to approach without assuming the entrance is unwatched.

brief: SOUTH exterior postern: overgrown path climbs sheltered passage in thick castle wall to LARGE IRON door, narrow arrow slits ten feet above ground. Locked but visually ordinary, no revealed guard inside, raised portcullis, moat or magic barrier. Woodland daylight.
